findings.evidenceJa: 一人になって考えてみよう
findings.governingReading: spend a little longer thinking by myself
findings.explanation: The English drops the article in “for a while” and loses the sense of continuing a little longer.

findings.highlight: I probably fell asleep because I could not think of anything
findings.evidenceJa: 畳に寝転んだ瞬間、今までの疲れが吹き出たのか
findings.governingReading: Perhaps all my accumulated fatigue burst out the instant I lay down on the tatami
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the stated physical cause of sleep with failure to devise a plan.

findings.evidenceJa: 抵抗する間もなく眠って
findings.governingReading: I fell asleep before I had any chance to resist
findings.explanation: The speed and involuntary force of Shirou’s exhaustion disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 一生頭が上がらなくなってたところだ
findings.governingReading: I would never have been able to hold my head up to Tohsaka for the rest of my life
findings.explanation: A lasting comic shift in their interpersonal standing becomes momentary embarrassment.

findings.highlight: trying to make myself look straight
findings.governingReading: hurriedly straightening my clothes and appearance
findings.explanation: “Look straight” is malformed and obscures Shirou physically tidying himself.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka glares at me the instant I see her
findings.evidenceJa: 自分から呼んだクセに、会うなり人を睨みつけて
findings.governingReading: She called me here herself, yet glares at me the instant we meet
findings.explanation: Shirou’s complaint about the contradiction in Rin’s conduct disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 気になったものは仕方がない
findings.explanation: A third branch turns Shirou’s curiosity into obligation.

findings.highlight: locks the door, and walks to the back of the room
findings.evidenceJa: がちゃん、と鍵をかけて、ずかずかと奥に戻る
findings.governingReading: locks the door with a click and strides heavily back into the room
findings.explanation: A third branch omits the audible lock and Rin’s forceful gait.

findings.highlight: used his riches to collect all the magic-resistant equipment in the world
findings.evidenceJa: 金にあかせて対魔術の武装を纏ってる
findings.governingReading: uses his wealth to outfit himself with anti-Magecraft armaments
findings.explanation: A third branch invents exhaustive worldwide collection.
